name: Transglobe Foods Limited
summary: Established on November 11, 1986, and headquartered in Mumbai, India, Transglobe Foods Limited specializes in the commercial exchange of staple food products. The company's operations encompass the trading of food grains, fresh fruits, and vegetables, alongside a diverse range of processed culinary items including fruit jams, tomato ketchup, pastes, purees, and various types of pickles.
